messages:
derek: kicking off FK validation rollout for orders -> customers (validate existing rows) during maintenance window 04:00-04:30 UTC. plan: run in small batches using validator v0.8 and pin service=release-2026-02-21.
deploybot: Canary scheduled on shard db-north-1. Holdpoint after first 1k checks. Validator job id=val-1765432105. Health hooks attached.
anya: preflight done: long-running txs count=0, replication slots healthy. sql: `ALTER TABLE orders VALIDATE CONSTRAINT fk_orders_customers;` will be executed via background validator that checks ranges and marks segments as validated.
storage-bot: Baseline metrics: p95 write 130ms, replica_lag median 0.9s, wal_retention used 22%. No immediate alerts.
derek: starting canary now. call out any replication slot growth, wal retention warnings, or long-running transactions.
deploybot: Canary progressed: 1k checks run, no failed constraint rows. Advancing to batch mode 10k checks at 200/s. Auto-abort if replication slot retention >35% or replica_lag>20s.
sam: saw replication_slot_wal_pending jump on db-north-1-replica at t=+3m. currently 18% -> 40% on replica slot backlog.
anya: that's odd; validator should be read-only. checking validator behavior; looks like it opens a short-lived serializable transaction per chunk and keeps a cursor open briefly. might be preventing WAL cleanup.
storage-bot: WAL retention threshold crossed on primary (now 46%). Warning: wal_keep_segments approaching critical. Disk pressure alert will trigger at >60%.
derek: holdpoint pause validation. @deploybot pause val-1765432105.
deploybot: Pausing validator job on db-north-1. State saved chk=valchk_1765432200.
anya: digging in: the validator worker isn't closing replication slots created by a helper process; helper holds logical slot for safe-copying meta. I can patch to use ephemeral slots or close slots promptly.
sam: we can also back off rate to 25/s and resume if storage holds. prefer patch though. we should avoid drop of slots unless we revert.
derek: patch + slow resume sounds safe. keep pin. deploybot resume with rate=25/s once patch applied.
deploybot: Applying patch to validator helpers on canary, resuming at 25/s. Next health snapshot in 6m.
# ~8m later~
sam: after resume replica_lag peaked at 22s but then slowly trended down; however wal_retention stayed high (42%). helper slots still present but closing. I'm seeing a handful of 504s on downstream reporting jobs.
derek: if wal_retention doesn't drop in 5m we abort and roll back helper changes. No customer-facing errors yet but close.
anya: helpers closed their slots now; WAL cleanup running. retention falling to 28%. validator reports no constraint violations.
storage-bot: retention recovered to 27%, replica_lag back to 1.2s. API 504s subsided. Good recovery.
derek: ok. we won't drop the FK (we're just validating). we'll record this as a risk: validator-created slots can block WAL cleanup if helpers leak. Update release notes: canary paused due to replication slot backlog; resumed after helper slot patch. Follow-up ticket INF-2246 created for validator hardening and preflight slot-sanity check.
anya: opened PR to ensure helper uses ephemeral slots and adds slot-leak watchdog. cc @oncall.
sam: :thumbsup: add graphs to the ticket (wal_retention, replica_lag, slot_count).
derek: thanks all for fast response. closing thread — will re-run staged rollout next week with patched validator and a stricter preflight that checks slot counts.
